user.title: Heat pump and storage tank
user.description: To heat up, the integration briefly sets the hot water setpoints to the target temperature and restores the previous values afterwards.

data_description.name: Device name in Home Assistant.
data_description.temperatur: Measured temperature in the hot water tank.
data_description.sollwerte: All setpoints the heat pump uses for hot water, e.g. comfort and eco.
data_description.heizt: Optional. Binary sensor that is on while the heat pump heats hot water. Used to detect whether heating starts or stops, and to tell hot water draws from heating.
data_description.sperren: Optional, e.g. utility lock or your own reheat script. While one of them is on, no automatic heat-up starts.
data_description.ziel: Temperature to heat up to. 60 °C is recommended.
data_description.erfolg_ab: From this measured tank temperature the heat-up counts as done.
data_description.max_dauer: If the temperature is not reached by then, the integration stops and restores the setpoints.

pv.title: Solar power and home battery
pv.description: Optional. Without solar data, the integration only heats up at the duty time.

data_description.pv: One or more power sensors of the solar system. They are added up; W and kW are detected.
data_description.pv_ab: From this solar power on there is a surplus.
data_description.akku: Home battery level. Without it, only solar power counts.
data_description.akku_ab: Surplus only once the battery is at least this full.
data_description.pv_dauer: The conditions must be met for this many minutes without interruption.
data_description.pv_von: Heating up with solar surplus only happens in this time window.
data_description.pv_bis: End of the solar time window.

data_description.pv_ab_tag: This many days after the last heat-up, solar surplus may be used to heat up again.
data_description.spaetestens_tag: If nothing has happened by this day, the tank is heated at the duty time, using grid power if needed. 7 = once a week.
data_description.pflicht_uhrzeit: If a lock is active at this time, the duty heat-up starts up to 6 hours later.
data_description.stillstand_tage: If no hot water has been drawn for this long, the tank is heated earlier (preferably with solar). 0 turns this off.
data_description.zapf_schwelle: If the tank temperature drops by this much within 15 minutes while the heat pump is not heating, it counts as a draw.
data_description.benachrichtigen: Optional. Message after every heat-up, e.g. to your phone via the Home Assistant app.

error.keine_sollwerte: Please select at least one hot water setpoint.
error.erfolg_ueber_ziel: "Done from" must not be higher than the target temperature.
error.schon_verwendet: There already is a legionella heat-up for this temperature sensor.
error.pv_fenster: The end of the solar time window must be after its start.
error.pv_nach_pflicht: "With solar surplus from day" must not be greater than "At the latest on day".
